$comment: Rename to settings.json (project-shared) or settings.local.json (personal, gitignored). The hooks below are live once copied: delete any you don't want. They read the edited file's path from the JSON Claude Code sends on stdin, so they need jq. See https://code.claude.com/docs/en/hooks for the full schema.
$comment_validation: The format-on-save and secret-file-blocking hooks below are a recommendation, not a universal convention. If your project adopts a worktree-per-feature workflow, add SessionStart/WorktreeCreate/WorktreeRemove hooks pointing at your own scripts — not included here since they're project-specific.

permissions.$comment: Pre-approve common safe commands so you stop seeing prompts.

env.$comment: Project-wide env hints for the AI. Real secrets go in appsettings.*.json / user-secrets / .env (gitignored), never here.

hooks.$comment_PostToolUse: Run after each Edit/Write to auto-format C#/TS files. Delete if you don't want format-on-save.

hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in *.cs) dotnet format --include "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1 ;; esac; exit 0
f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in *.ts|*.tsx) npx --no-install prettier --write "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1 ;; esac; exit 0

hooks.$comment_PreToolUse: Block edits to sensitive/secret files. Delete if you don't want it.

PreToolUse.$comment: Example: refuse to edit local secrets or environment files.

hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | grep -qE '(appsettings\.Local|appsettings\.Development)\.json$|(^|/)\.env(\..*)?$' && { echo 'Blocked: do not edit local secret/config files' >&2; exit 2; } || exit 0

hooks.$comment_Stop: Runs when Claude finishes a reply. Empty here: add your own if you need one.
